The FFmpeg libraries used by this program (libavcodec, libavutil) are licensed under the GNU LGPL
version 2.1 or later (FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt, the COPYING.LGPLv2.1 of the FFmpeg source tree) and are
never built with --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree.

How they reach the program depends on the platform, and this note covers both:

  Windows: the pinned build below is shipped next to the executable and dynamically linked.

  Linux: this archive carries no FFmpeg. The program links against the FFmpeg of the distribution it
  is installed on, which the package manager keeps patched, so the version is whatever that
  distribution ships. Install its runtime package (for example `ffmpeg` on Arch, or the
  `libavcodec`/`libavutil` runtime packages on Debian and Ubuntu).

The pinned build below is the one the Windows archive ships. Its object files can be relinked under
another licence: the same source, configuration and compiler settings reproduce them.

Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz
SHA-256: de668509caf9e35e3cd162473441fdb29538c6d96ed080292b3cf9e6fc5d558f
Configured with: --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-programs --disable-doc --disable-avdevice --disable-avformat --disable-avfilter --disable-swscale --disable-swresample --disable-network --disable-autodetect --disable-everything --enable-decoder=h264 --enable-decoder=atrac3 --enable-decoder=atrac3p --disable-x86asm --disable-debug
